goal: Turn Mission Control from a visual portfolio map into a calm workflow router that shows who owns the next move, what can continue without Michael, what is blocked, and the exact next action for each core mission.
constraints: Keep all core missions visible by default.
Do not infer agent ownership from roadmap prose.
Keep public Pages read-only and private-safe.
done_when: Every core project displays a workflow lane.
Exact next move comes from the active execution contract.
User can scan/filter YOUR MOVE, CAN CONTINUE and BLOCKED without losing the roadmap.
Latest wins remain visible but compact.
CI protects routing truth and visual density.

evidence.observation: workflow ownership is sourced from active-task.next_owner; stale execution truth becomes NEEDS CONTRACT

uncertainties: Final workflow usefulness is still a human judgement after live deployment.
next_step: Merge Council PR #19, refresh GitHub Pages and verify the live v0.9 route.
